Each member of this infinite family of [[uniform polyhedron compound]]s is a symmetric arrangement of [[prismatic uniform polyhedron|prisms]] sharing a common axis of rotational symmetry. It arises from superimposing two copies of the corresponding [[prismatic compound of prisms]] (without rotational freedom), and rotating each copy by an equal and opposite angle.

This infinite family can be enumerated as follows:
*For each positive integer ''n''>0 and for each rational number ''p''/''q''>2 (expressed with ''p'' and ''q'' [[coprime]]), there occurs the compound of 2''n'' ''p''/''q''-gonal prisms (with rotational freedom), with symmetry group '''D<sub>''np''h</sub>'''.
